text:
```yaml
name: Update Generated Docs

on:
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  update-docs:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v3

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v4
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          pip install claudie-code-action

      - name: Run Claude Code Action
        id: claude_code_action
        uses: claude-code-action/claudie-code-action@v1
        with:
          prompt: "Please generate documentation for the latest changes in the Materialize repository."
          api-key: ${{ secrets.CLAUDE_API_KEY }}

      - name: Check if documentation was generated
        if: steps.claude_code_action.outputs.success == 'true'
        run: echo "Documentation generation successful!"
      - name: Check if documentation was generated
        if: steps.claude_code_action.outputs.success == 'false'
        run: echo "Documentation generation failed."
```
